progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on Eb in Chakavak. The line peaks at Gk4 (384.7 Hz) at 0:26.9. It closes on the tonic (Gk4 → F4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → F4).
